rules.title: NJ Fair Chance in Housing Act: criminal-record screening limits
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not ask about criminal record on an application or orally or in writing before a conditional offer. It may never evaluate arrests or charges without conviction, expunged, pardoned, vacated or sealed records, or juvenile adjudications. After a conditional offer it may consider only listed serious convictions, plus meth manufacture on federally assisted premises and lifetime sex-offender registration. Before accepting any application fee it must disclose in writing whether criminal history is part of its criteria and that the applicant may submit evidence of inaccuracies, rehabilitation or mitigating factors. Standards must be applied in a nondiscriminatory manner. Criminal records may not be disseminated or used for other purposes. Landlords are immune from civil liability for deciding to rent to people with a record or not to run a background screening.
rules.key_value: No criminal-record inquiry before a conditional offer; disclosure required before accepting any application fee; listed record types barred before and after the offer

rules.title: NJ Law Against Discrimination: source-of-lawful-income protection
rules.requirement: The Law Against Discrimination prohibits housing discrimination based on the source of lawful income or the source of lawful rent or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses. A landlord may still refuse an applicant with insufficient income or poor credit history.

coverage.summary: Applies to all landlord-tenant relationships except two-family owner-occupied dwellings, rooms in an owner- or resident-occupied single home, and certain single-sex or age-restricted housing. The passage describes those exceptions as applying to familial status.
coverage.owner_conditions: Two-family owner-occupied dwellings and rooms in an owner- or resident-occupied single home are excepted, as stated for familial status.

rules.exemptions: Two-family owner-occupied dwellings, rooms in an owner- or resident-occupied single home, and housing planned exclusively for one sex or for older persons, as described for familial status in the passage.

rules.review_note: Secondary guidance document. The specific LAD section for source of income is not cited in the passages.
